prompt.text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed portrait 2D raster game-board background, intended for a 551 by 984 pixel mobile game scene, portrait aspect ratio 551:984 (approximately 9:16).
Primary request: a bright candy-colored isometric board-game world, rendered as a single new original 2D illustration with polished soft cartoon shading. Use a high oblique isometric view. A wide continuous path of individual pale cream and very light mint square board tiles enters from the left around the upper-middle, travels diagonally southeast across the central scene toward the lower right, then makes a readable corner turn toward the bottom edge. The tile path is the dominant compositional diagonal. Plain tiles with occasional simple pictorial icons only, absolutely no writing or numbers on any tile.
Scene/backdrop: rounded vivid green grassy islands surrounded by a winding turquoise and mint water stream. A giant whimsical layered cake building occupies the upper-right background: tall pink frosting sides with coral, orange and cream cake layers, soft rounded candy architecture. A wide pastel rainbow ribbon sweeps downward from near the upper-left edge into the middle background. A small simple orange wooden bench can sit on the upper-left green lawn. A few oversized yellow candy-star decorations sit on the ground.
Board details: several small bright red house blocks sit directly on selected board tiles, interspersed with a few small chunky gold coin discs. Place a tiny purple-and-blue toy game token on one central tile, and two small friendly cartoon toy figures on the green/stream-side area near the center and lower-left; one figure in an orange-red cap and another with pale blonde hair and a small blue outfit. Keep all tokens visually small in the scene. Large clean rounded shapes, crisp tile edges and gentle compact contact shading.
Composition: full scene fills all four edges, no empty letterbox margins. The diagonal board, turquoise stream and green land remain clearly visible across the center. Cake is partially cropped by the upper-right edge. Rainbow ribbon near upper left. The image is background artwork only, with no overlaid interface.
Color and mood: vivid emerald and lime greens, turquoise water, creamy mint tiles, saturated red houses, gold coins, pink-orange cake, cheerful candy world. Friendly polished casual mobile-game artwork. Do not substitute a city skyline, realistic park, or landscape photograph.
Hard constraints: NO UI overlay of any kind: no top HUD, profile portrait, resource bars, event banner, side buttons, notification dots, badges, counters, reward panels, progress bars, bottom GO button, bottom menu/footer. No legible text, no letters, no digits or numbers anywhere, no logo, no watermark, no screenshot frame, no external UI shadow. Do not assemble or copy a screenshot. This is a newly drawn stand-alone background illustration, not a complete screen. Opaque canvas.

상단 HUD·좌우 event 버튼·배지·글자·숫자·하단 GO/footer는 원본 UI이며 이 배경에서 제외.

원본과 유사한 밝은 캔디 보드 구성의 새 그림이며 픽셀/폰트/원본 장면/실3D 동등을 주장하지 않음.
